title: Tara Swart's husband's death and doves

tellings.quote: her husband actually passed under unfortunate circumstances and then I think a bunch of doves showed up at her house

plain: Michels says that after the husband of a woman named Tara Swart died under unfortunate circumstances, a flock of doves showed up at her house. He tells it from memory, hedging with "I think", in a 2026 conversation about strange coincidences, as the kind of event that can feel like a message from beyond.
